def test_namedtuple_features():

    attr_map = {
        ('userName', None, None): 'username',

        ('emails', 'type', None): 'emails.type',

    lexer = SCIMLexer()

    ast = parser.parse(token_stream)
    sql, params = transpiler.transpile(ast)
    
    print("=== NAMED TUPLE FUNCTIONALITY TEST ===")
    print(f"Filter: {filter_string}")
    print(f"Generated SQL: {sql}")
    
    # Get the first (and only) path

    print(f"Type: {type(path)}")

    print(f"path[0] (attr_name): {path[0]}")
    print(f"path[1] (sub_attr): {path[1]}")
    print(f"path[2] (uri): {path[2]}")
    
    # Test new functionality - named access
    print("\n--- New Named Access ---")
    print(f"path.attr_name: {path.attr_name}")
    print(f"path.sub_attr: {path.sub_attr}")
    print(f"path.uri: {path.uri}")
    
    # Test that it behaves like a tuple in other ways

    print(f"Length: {len(path)}")
    print(f"Iteration: {list(path)}")
    print(f"Unpacking: attr, sub, uri = path -> attr='{path[0]}', sub='{path[1]}', uri='{path[2]}'")
    
    # Test equality
    regular_tuple = ('userName', None, None)
    print(f"\nEquality with regular tuple: {path == regular_tuple}")
    print(f"Equality is symmetric: {regular_tuple == path}")
    
    # Test that it's actually a NamedTuple
    print(f"\nIs instance of AttrPathTuple: {isinstance(path, AttrPathTuple)}")
    print(f"NamedTuple fields: {path._fields}")
